description:
Follow-up enhancements for the TigerData cloud deployment mode
(timescaledb:cloud), split from completed timescaledb-cloud-deployment.

The core rebrand and cloud connection logic is done. These items improve
security posture, connection flexibility, and test confidence but require
a live TigerData account to implement and verify.

preserves.behavior: All existing cloud unit tests continue to pass

work_units.notes:
TigerData provides three connection endpoints per service:
- Direct (port 5432): standard PostgreSQL connection
- Session pool: connection pooling with session affinity
- Transaction pool: connection pooling per transaction
Each uses a different port. Add a pool_mode option to _configure_cloud_mode()
and document the port mapping.
Requires a live TigerData account to test pool behavior differences.
work_units.summary: Add connection pooling mode selection (direct, session pool, transaction pool) - TigerData offers three connection modes on different ports

work_units.notes:
TigerData recommends verify-full but sslmode=require works today.
Needs a CA cert distribution strategy: bundled cert, system trust store,
or user-provided path via TIGERDATA_SSLROOTCERT / platform option.
Consider following the pattern used by other cloud adapters.
work_units.summary: Add sslmode=verify-full support with CA certificate configuration

work_units.notes:
Create pytest markers for live TigerData tests (e.g., @pytest.mark.tigerdata).
Test connection, basic query, hypertable creation, and compression on a real
TigerData instance. Skip by default; run only when TIGERDATA_HOST is set.
All code paths are already covered by unit tests.
work_units.summary: Add integration smoke tests with live TigerData account
